name: zinput_di_release_joystick_ref
description: zInput::DI_ReleaseJoystickRef decrements the joystick poll reference count when it is nonzero and returns the resulting count.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x471d80 loads the 16-bit joystick poll refcount, decrements and stores it only when the unsigned value is greater than zero, and returns the resulting zero-extended count.
Native smoke zinput_joystick_ref_and_enable_smoke verifies release-at-zero stays zero and releases from two to one then one to zero after enabled AddJoystickRef calls.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x471d80 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a zInput joystick reference-count pass.
